one_line: A Nattukottai Chettiar merchant-banker managing hundi-based credit networks across South and Southeast Asia in the late 19th–early 20th centuries.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, medium height, slightly solid build suggesting prosperity but not softness
appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown Chettinad complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed moustache, faint stubble shadow along the jaw, calm but calculating eyes, default expression a composed half-smile that hides cautious scrutiny
appearance.hair: black hair oiled and combed back from the forehead, tied into a small low knot at the back of the head, with a simple white angavastram-style head cloth (thin band of cloth) folded and wrapped loosely around the crown like a narrow turban band, leaving the top of the head mostly visible
appearance.costume: He wears a crisp off-white khadi veshti (dhoti) wrapped ankle-length with a narrow maroon border, pleated neatly at the front, paired with a long-sleeved light-cream cotton shirt (bush-shirt style) with a stand collar and wooden buttons, over which he drapes a thin white angavastram with a slim gold stripe over his left shoulder; around his neck is a short, subtle gold chain and a thin black-thread amulet, on his wrists simple thin gold bangles, and on his feet brown leather open sandals; when shown in overseas settings, the same dhoti and shirt are worn but the angavastram is tucked over the forearm and the sandals look slightly more worn, while the overall outfit remains modest and fully covering.
appearance.signature: A stiff leather-bound account ledger book in dark brown, held under his left arm, with a cloth bundle containing folded hundis and a short wooden writing stylus tucked into the ledger’s binding.

ref_desc: Middle-aged Nakarattar Chettiar banker with oiled black hair in a low knot and narrow white head cloth, wearing off-white veshti, cream long-sleeved shirt, white angavastram with gold stripe, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a dark-brown ledger with bundled hundis and wooden stylus in a warm off-white, cream, maroon, brown, and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a middle-aged Nakarattar Chettiar banker from late 19th–early 20th century South India: an oval-faced man with medium-brown complexion, sharp nose, neat moustache and a calm, shrewd expression, his black hair oiled back into a small low knot with a simple narrow white cloth wrapped around the crown like a thin turban band. He wears a crisp off-white ankle-length veshti with a narrow maroon border, a long-sleeved light-cream cotton shirt with a stand collar and wooden buttons, and a thin white angavastram with a slim gold stripe draped over his left shoulder, along with a short gold chain and black-thread amulet at his neck, thin gold bangles on his wrists, and brown leather open sandals. In his left arm he tucks a dark-brown leather-bound account ledger, with a small cloth bundle of folded hundis and a short wooden stylus tucked into the ledger’s binding; show him from front, side, and back in the same outfit and colors, emphasizing the off-white, cream, maroon, brown, and gold palette and the modest, fully draped, historically accurate merchant-banker look.
